def get_group(board, r, c):
    color = board[r][c]
    if color == 0: return set()
    group = set()
    stack = [(r,c)]
    while stack:
        cr, cc = stack.pop()
        if (cr, cc) in group:
            continue
        group.add((cr, cc))
        for nr, nc in neighbors(cr, cc):
            if board[nr][nc] == color:
                stack.append((nr, nc))
    return group

def count_liberties(board, group):

    for (r,c) in group:
        for nr, nc in neighbors(r,c):
            if board[nr][nc] == 0:
                liberties.add((nr,nc))
    return len(liberties)
